t: Din kibbud habbayit vedabar sheeno mitkavven
s: Din kibbud habbayit vedabar sheeno mitkavven ubo h' seipim: kol dabar sheeno mitkavven muttar apillu epshar biladayv, kegon mitta kisse vesapsal, ben gedolim ben qetannim — muttar legoreran al gabbe qarqa, ubilbad shello yitkavven laasot charitz. Veap im naasa charitz meelayv — en bekak kelum, ki dabar sheeno mitkavven hu. Veap al pi shehaqqetannim epshar lo littelan beyadayv veen tzarik legoreran — lo hitzriku lekak. Veken bekol dabar sheeno mitkavven. Abal haggedolim meod asur ligror, shebbevadday osin charitz, u"pesiq resheh velo yamut hu", veap al pi shechoper kilachar yad hu, veeno chayyab ella keshechoper bemara vekayyotze bo mehakkelim shedderek lachpor bahem, vegam meqalqel hu qarqait habbayit, vegam melaka sheenah tzerika legupah hi — ap al pi ken asur middibre soperim. Vaapillu beqarqa hamrutztzap beshayish vekayyotze bo shei epshar laasot bo charitz — asur ligror, gezera mishshum sheeno merutztzap:

Muttar lerabbetz habbayit, kevan sheeno mitkavven lehashvot haggumot ella shello yaaleh haabaq, velav "pesiq resheh" hu. Abal asur lekabbed habbayit, di"pesiq resheh" hu. Veim hu qarqa merutztzap baabanim, vekol shekken biqrashim, sheen lachush bo lehashvaat gumot — muttar lekabbedo (velo gazeru bo mishshum sheeno merutztzap, lepi shehakkibbud hu dabar sheyyesh bo tzorek hayyom). Vaapillu yesh bo aprurit uqelippe egozim vekayyotze bahem mehaddebarim haasurim betiltul — muttar lekabbedam, mippene shehem lo kigrap shel rei, shehitteyaru lo lehotzio laashpa mippene kebodo. Veyesh mattirin apillu besheeno merutztzap, delav "pesiq resheh" hu sheyyashveh gumot. Veyesh machmirin apillu bimrutztzap, gezera mishshum sheeno merutztzap. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu, veen leshannot. Abal nohagim lehaqel lekabbed al yede beged o matlit o kenap avvaz haqqallim veenan mashvin gumot. Veal yede nokri — muttar bekol inyan, shekkol "pesiq resheh" muttar al yede nokri, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"g:

Asur lekabbed habbegadim bemakbedot haasuyim miqqesamim, shello yishshaberu qismehem bi"pesiq resheh", vahare zeh soter keli. Veap shemmeqalqel patur, mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim, ayyen simman shy"d. (Veken makbedot haasuyin meanpe ilan — asur lekabbed bahem mittaam zeh, apillu beqarqa hamrutztzap ledibre hammattirin. Velo hittiru hammattirin ella bemakbedot shel temara, sheenah nishberet):

En sakin et haqqarqa, veen medichim oto, veen nopechim haqqarqa, shemma yabo lehashvot gumot. Vaapillu bimrutztzap asur ap ledibre hammattirin bekibbud, lepi sheddebarim ellu en bahem tzorek kol kak kemo bekibbud, lepikak lo ratzu lechalleq bahem ben merutztzap lesheeno merutztzap, veasur hakkol:

Asur letzadded chabit melea al haaretz, shekkevan shehi kebeda — yabo lehashvot gumot vadday bitzdadeha, u"pesiq resheh" hu. Veken lo yakria chabit veyishpok mimmenna, ella magbihah min haaretz, veshopek, sheim lo ken — yachpir min haaretz bevadday. Veap shemmeqalqel hu, vegam melaka sheenah tzerika legupah hi, vegam choper kilachar yad hu — ap al pi ken asur middibre soperim:
